messages.content: 想像一下你正在計劃在家裡度過一個溫馨的夜晚。你想要用一副撲克牌玩一個紙牌遊戲，但是你不確定這副牌裡是否有“紅心的國王”。你能檢查一下它是否在裡面嗎？之後，你打算煮一道需要兩杯糖的食譜，但是你只有一個湯匙來量。相當於兩杯糖有多少湯匙？另外，你的錢包裡有100歐元，你想知道它相當於美元多少。你能換算一下嗎？最後，你在考慮在花園裡添加一些新的植物。你住在舊金山，對提供“一年生”和“樹木”類型植物的苗圃有興趣。你能找到一些當地的苗圃嗎？

function.name: find_card_in_deck
function.description: Locate a particular card in a deck based on rank and suit. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

rank.description: Rank of the card (e.g. Ace, Two, King).

suit.description: Suit of the card (e.g. Hearts, Spades, Diamonds, Clubs).

deck.description: Deck of cards. If not provided, the deck will be a default standard 52 card deck

function.name: currency_exchange_convert
function.description: Convert an amount from a base currency to a target currency based on the current exchange rate. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

amount.description: The amount in base currency to convert

function.name: local_nursery_find
function.description: Locate local nurseries based on location and plant types availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city or locality where the nursery needs to be located.

plant_types.description: Type of plants the nursery should provide.

function.name: recipe_unit_conversion
function.description: Convert a value from one kitchen unit to another for cooking purposes. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

from_unit.description: The unit to convert from. Supports 'teaspoon', 'tablespoon', 'cup', etc.

to_unit.description: The unit to convert to. Supports 'teaspoon', 'tablespoon', 'cup', etc.

precision.description: The precision to round the output to, in case of a non-integer result. Optional, default is 0.

message.reasoning:
The user wants multiple tasks:

1. Check if a deck contains "King of Hearts". They didn't provide a deck, so we can assume default standard 52-card deck. We need to use find_card_in_deck function.

2. Convert 2 cups of sugar to teaspoons? Wait they said "two cups sugar" but only have a tablespoon to measure. They want to know how many tablespoons equal two cups. So convert 2 cups to tablespoons. Use recipe_unit_conversion.

3. Convert 100 euros to dollars. Use currency_exchange_convert.

4. Find local nurseries in San Francisco that provide "Annual" and "Tree" types. Use local_nursery_find.

We need to call each function. The user didn't specify the deck, so we can pass no deck param. For the unit conversion, we need to convert from cup to tablespoon. For currency, base_currency: EUR, target_currency: USD, amount: 100. For nursery, location: "San Francisco", plant_types: ["Annual", "Tree"].

We need to call each function separately. The user wants all results. We'll call them in order.

We need to produce the function calls. The user didn't ask for explanation, just the results. But we can provide the results after calling functions. We'll do the calls.

We need to use the function calls. We'll do them sequentially.

We need to output the function calls. We'll do them in separate calls. We'll produce the calls.
